steps: observe bonus hard surfaces and ordinary side hard objects
reproduction.reported: Bonus hard objects are almost impossible to touch; ordinary hard objects are also rarely encountered.

acceptance: Bonus hard surfaces occupy the active mid-lane and remain readable escape choices.
Normal input can intentionally intersect a bonus spike in both target viewports.
Ordinary hard blocks register a deliberate near-edge body/handle contact without pixel-perfect alignment.
No decorative-only object is counted as gameplay pressure; existing cut, recovery, and finish semantics remain intact.
reason: The complaint spans the Bonus core loop and ordinary collision semantics, so it requires QA -> Fixer -> QA retest rather than a cosmetic patch.
